title: One reply from the character's language model
description: The one shape ai_llm accepts. A game narrows `intent` to the discourse acts it declared (LlmValidator.json_schema, gameaikit.llm.validator.json_schema) and hands that to a runtime that can constrain its output -- a convenience: the validator checks every reply anyway, including the rules a schema cannot say (an argument belongs to its intent, no line break, no markup, no secret).

speech.description: What the character says: one line, no markup.

intent.description: Which of the game's declared discourse acts the player's words were.

argument.description: One of that intent's declared values, or empty.
